crossRefs.note: “Speak, you who ride on white donkeys, you who sit on rich carpets, and you who walk by the way.
He had forty sons and thirty sons’ sons who rode on seventy donkey colts. He judged Israel eight years.
Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.
Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called…

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Havvoth-jair
people.line: Villages in Gilead captured by Jair

translations.web: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkey colts. They had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth Jair to this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
translations.bsb: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkeys. And they had thirty towns in the land of Gilead, which to this day are called Havvoth-jair.
translations.kjv: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havothjair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
translations.asv: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth-jair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
